name: alpha
description: Fixture skill for the toolkit-path lint tests.

# alpha

Prose names ToolkitRoot, never a home-directory path.

```sh
# A fence comment may name ~/.claude/skills: a comment is not a read.
ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"
if [ -f .adlc/partials/forge.sh ]; then . .adlc/partials/forge.sh; else . "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/partials/forge.sh"; fi
```

1. An indented fence keeps the root line exempt:

   ```sh
   ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/partials" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="$HOME/.claude/skills"; [ -n "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT" ] || ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/adlc/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); export ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT="${ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills}"
   cat "$ADLC_TOOLKIT_ROOT/ETHOS.md"
   ```
